name: Calagopus servers
author: Brick_Bread
description: Watches the servers on a Calagopus panel: an overview card, alerts in the pill, and a tab to browse your servers, see their live stats, send console commands and start, stop, restart or kill them. Connects to the panel URL you configure, using your API key.

settings.label: Panel address
settings.description: The web address of your Calagopus panel.

settings.label: API key
settings.description: A user API key with access to your servers. Stored encrypted for your Windows account; leave empty to keep the stored key.

settings.label: Only these servers
settings.description: Names or ids, one per line. Empty shows every server.

settings.label: Hide these servers
settings.description: Names or ids, one per line.
